# Intentionally Insecure Repository Test Fixtures

This directory houses mock, inert repository fixtures containing intentional configuration weaknesses, outdated dependency manifests, and simulated credential patterns for testing scanner detection accuracy.

> [!CAUTION]
> **SYNTHETIC DATA ONLY**:  
> Fixtures in this directory contain **only synthetic, non-functional mock patterns**. Real production credentials, functional exploits, or live attack payloads are strictly prohibited.
